study.question: Can bounded bucket-count distributions replace the two exact category/brand frequency sorts in g2-r0016-log_local while retaining validation utility and reducing measured full-unit cost? Source inspection establishes that two sorts remain; it does not establish that they dominate cost. The parent has AUC 0.6202837665, Logloss 0.1959750415, train 440.833s, wall 534.906s and inference 18.951s, versus frozen joint_identity AUC 0.6204259428, train 548.358s and inference 19.218s. All are single-seed observations.
study.hypothesis: Coarse within-target-group marginal repetition/diversity may suffice for the residual correction; exact identity-frequency partitions may be unnecessary after retaining target-match statistics, coarse action-age tables and local log-weighted fine recency. Fixed hash coarsening of category/brand distributions preserves total complete-pair mass, lowers or preserves empirical entropy and raises or preserves empirical collision mass. Smaller fixed tables remove sorting but introduce aliases. These are hashed-distribution statistics, not unbiased estimates of the original entropy or collision mass. Utility retention and cost reduction are separate empirical hypotheses.

nearest_work.difference: Direct parent. Preserve all learned modules and the 28-coordinate identity head; only replace exact category/brand identity partitions by deterministic fixed-size bucket partitions. Original selected independent product features remain algebraic products of the selected marginal summaries.

Frozen quality reference includes event-embedding pools/moments and exact joint category-brand concentration. The compact parent already removes those event embedding consumers and uses marginal-product identity features. This experiment isolates additional marginal-distribution coarsening, not pairing necessity.

DIN inherits embedding/MLP and target-conditioned pooling; our parent uses hard category/brand match groups and aggregate counts, with no learned event-attention scoring. Local baseline_din uses normalized attention whereas primary DIN relaxes unit-mass normalization (lines 272-277), so no exact reproduction claim.

Author README confirms category/brand/type histories lack item IDs. Proposed distributions summarize supplied bucket identities only; not product identities. Full paper unavailable in the authorized cache; detailed DMR equivalence is unverified.

UniDAC overview mentions fixed-budget hashing for sparse embedding capacity, unlike our fixed count-distribution coarsening with unchanged embeddings. No older/recent branch, cross-domain exchange, ID dropout or external result transfer. Generic hashing is prior technique; specialized novelty remains unverified. Registry search hashing returned no primary hashing paper.

inherited_components: Frozen causal data construction, first-six-day natural-ratio training, validation identity/scorer, 128-event supplied prefix, three epochs, batch 4096 and seed 42. Raw tables and host runtime internals are unavailable as research inputs; no reacquisition or protocol modification.

Static embeddings, action/recency tables, target-match groups, four target-match log counts, observed group/action/coarse-age tables, local normalized log fine-recency weights and empirical action means.

Same 158/64 main MLP at 18 fields and 28/16/1 bias-free residual head initialized with zero final weights; exact same nn allocation order/shapes and default host optimization. Parent measured 17155911 total parameters, 77831 active nonstatic parameters, +214 versus frozen reference target.

Complete-pair support excludes category/brand zero for both marginals. The 28 features are four groups of log support count, category entropy, brand entropy, category collision, brand collision, entropy sum and collision product. All same scale math.log(129).
study.proposed_difference: Use integer h_s(x)=(((x mod 2147483647)*a_s+b_s) mod 2147483647) mod M, with fixed (a,b)=(1103515245,12345) or (1664525111,1013904223). Scatter complete-pair counts into B x (4M) tables separately for category and brand. Compute entropy and collision directly over bins, then the unchanged empirical-product coordinates. M=64 and M=256 use nested bins under mapping 0; mapping 1 checks arbitrary alias dependence at M=256. Hashes consume only already-supplied IDs, never labels, learned state, foreign-user events or external files. Empty groups yield zeros. Training forward builds no BxLxL arrays and performs zero identity sorts in sketch cells; exact tables/dense equalities are diagnostics only. This is a controlled compression implementation, with no priority claim.
predictions: Sketch and exact cells have identical parameter counts and scratch parameter draws; exact_replay should recover parent features numerically and establish a contemporary performance/cost reference. Earlier same-seed g2-r0014-local_product vs g2-r0016-mean_local differ in AUC by about 0.000149, so small observed gains must remain preliminary.

Both sketches preserve support counts and all nonidentity features. Hash coarsening decreases entropy and increases collision mass; mapping-0 256 bins has entropy no smaller and collision mass no larger than mapping-0 64 bins, up to rounding. Dense equality on hashed IDs should match scatter statistics.

Provisional utility screen, declared before execution: AUC deficit <=0.0002 against exact_replay AND <=0.0003 against frozen g1-r0012-joint_identity, and Logloss increase <=0.0002 against exact_replay. These margins are decision rules, not proof of equivalence or statistical significance.

A useful cheaper implementation must also reduce measured training seconds or full validation inference seconds by >=5% against exact_replay, without exceeding the other cost by >5%; record wall time, throughput, p50/p95 latency, peak memory and all parameters. Otherwise describe a utility result without an efficiency gain.

If coarse recurrence is sufficient, both mappings at 256 bins should meet the utility screen; the 64-bin quality/cost tradeoff may be worse. Mapping agreement is a robustness check, not independent random initialization or proof of identity-renaming invariance.
falsifiers: No sketch meets the quality screen: reject these bounded-distribution implementations, not all history compression.
Quality retained but no measured >=5% cost reduction: reject the claimed efficiency benefit, even with zero sorts. Larger scatter tables and integer remainder kernels may outweigh sort removal.

Only one 256-bin mapping improves or a material map gap exceeds 0.0002 AUC: alias sensitivity undermines a robust sufficiency explanation; require a discriminating follow-up and additional maps before promotion.

Nonzero mass/padding/empty errors, coarse monotonicity violations above floating-point tolerance, or scatter versus dense hashed statistic error above 1e-5 blocks a mechanism claim until corrected. Candidate diagnostics are first-512 code-authored checks, not independently verified population evidence.
alternative_explanations: Hash aliases can regularize, introduce ID-dependent structure or interact with fixed bucket encodings; good AUC need not mean exact diversity is irrelevant. Unlike exact statistics, sketches are not invariant under arbitrary category/brand renaming.

Scratch optimization/host nondeterminism, best-epoch selection and the changed distribution seen by the same small residual head may explain tiny differences. Seed 42 replay is not an independent repeat.
Main MLP/static embedding cost and causal feature gathering may dominate; parameter matching does not ensure compute matching. Fixed-size count tables can increase peak memory despite removing sorts.

The first-512 parent diagnostic shows 85.16% at history cap and mean 118.12 visible events, with most in the neither-match group; those measurements are not full-population distributions and justify no claim about unseen longer histories.

Earlier compact/matched and pairing-fold trajectories mixed retained utility, capacity and disrupted information; fine-action observed 0.61998665 versus conditional 0.62007423 was null/negative. Local-vs-factorized recency gains persisted in mean and log cells, but log-vs-mean gains were small (0.000079 local, 0.000161 factorized). No single experiment establishes a mechanism.

Pre-execution source review abandoned small affine multipliers 104729/130363: for low IDs before the first prime wrap, odd affine maps can induce the same modulo partitions despite different salts. Final larger multipliers increase prime wrapping over low integer IDs; effectiveness on actual field distributions remains unmeasured. No training, validation scoring or host calls used the abandoned mapping; arbitrary-map robustness remains empirical.

contrasts.intervention: sketch64 and sketch256 replace exact empirical marginal partitions by nested fixed bucket partitions under mapping 0.
contrasts.control: exact_replay recomputes exact category/brand entropy/collision from two sorts. Existing g2-r0016-log_local is an additional lineage reference; frozen joint_identity and baseline-din remain quality/cost anchors.
held_fixed: All visible histories, fields, complete-pair mask and target grouping
Model allocation order, parameters, optimizer/loss, seed, training passes and scorer
Local log fine recency and all nonidentity feature computations; support counts and 28-coordinate head interface
remaining_confounds: Changed input geometry/regularization and deterministic alias patterns
Different actual integer/scatter/sort work; capacity matched, computation deliberately measured rather than forced equal
One initial seed and best-epoch selection
contrasts.decision_if_supported: If quality and cost screens pass, reserve paired validation repetitions against exact and frozen controls before claiming retained utility; prefer the measured Pareto frontier, not minimum sort count.
contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: Report quality loss and/or no efficiency benefit; 256 versus 64 and diagnostic error magnitude discriminate alias loss from kernel/memory overhead. Do not tune on any withheld outcome.

contrasts.intervention: sketch256_alt changes only fixed hash mapping, keeping 256 bins.
contrasts.control: sketch256 uses mapping 0 with identical table dimensions and modules.
held_fixed: Same trainable weights at initialization, selected hyperparameters and training protocol
Same count table sizes, feature dimensions, support and nonidentity information
remaining_confounds: Two maps do not characterize all hash choices
Alias changes can alter optimization and implicit regularization together
contrasts.decision_if_supported: If both meet predeclared utility/cost screens, retain provisional robustness support and freeze before paired-seed assessment.
contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: Record map sensitivity and avoid selecting a lucky mapping as mechanism confirmation; a later predeclared multi-map or alternative sketch contrast would be required.

cost_plan.estimate_ref: runtime protocol estimated_unit_seconds=704.37297296, trial_cap_seconds=1760.9324324; remaining_seconds=37148.73057 at resolution. Parent g2-r0016-log_local wall 534.906s, exact replay/three sketches provision 4*704.373=2817.492s expected and 4*1760.932=7043.730s capped. All preparation, diagnostics, failures and repetitions count; no local training or package installation. Local verification completed without Torch: exact schema/protocol/evidence checks, four syntax/AST/import/config checks, identical nn allocation calls and unchanged inherited feature/forward methods; 128 standard-library synthetic count/hash contrasts, max dense-reference discrepancy 2.220446049250313e-15. No training, validation scoring or installation. First local check failed an overly restrictive map-witness assertion on IDs 1..128: both 256-bin maps were injective there, which is not an algorithm failure. Expanding the synthetic identifier domain to 1..512 found witness (1, 368), usable as a two-event history if IDs are available. No model or hash mapping was changed after that failed check. Failed-check preparation cost remains charged; this scalar reference does not execute Torch kernels.
cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Reserve 6000 seconds for a consequential discrepancy or alias/capacity diagnostic, including failed attempts. Four submitted cells include exact contemporary control and map robustness; candidate diagnostics cost is charged. No duplicate execution after an unknown host state.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Reserve 14000 seconds for validation-only final suite, targeting paired seeds 42,43,44 for the selected compact implementation, exact parent, frozen joint_identity and DIN plus any necessary nearest ablation. Freeze source/config/checkpoint hashes, selected suite, seeds and host assessment commands before assessment. User-cluster paired bootstrap only if authorized paired predictions become available; currently none are supplied. No test request or closed archive access.
cost_plan.stop_rule: Stop on hard ledger/trial cap or integrity failure; do not raise limits. Four trials at cap plus 6000 attribution and 14000 assessment reserves total 27043.73 seconds, leaving about 10105 seconds for preparation/contingency at snapshot. Submit only this proposal phase; host executes. Future follow-up must fit the actual remaining ledger. Null/failed outcomes remain in host receipts; no permission to edit shared evidence or human knowledge.
